calibration_cluster_unit: target gene containing both guide replicates
centroid_upper: constant target-cluster split-conformal quantile of the maximum centroid RMSE across both guides of each calibration target
evaluation_cluster_unit: target gene containing both guide replicates
primary_truth_vector: guide-level mean log1p-normalized expression minus pooled negative-guide control mean on a frozen 512-gene panel
registered_family_rms_error: sqrt(mean_i RMSE(prediction_i, truth)^2) across ten models
worst_member_lower: maximum pairwise family distance divided by two
